nine_node_submission_roots.creation: tracked fsbdd.auxiliary.stage1.submit prepare-nine helper performs exclusive mkdir before qsub
nine_node_submission_roots.marker: identical submission-root.json in shared and result roots

remaining_submission_identity_policy.tracked_repository_files: require a clean worktree, record the actual Git commit and retained paths, and compute runtime identities inside the job; no caller-supplied repository-file hash gate
remaining_submission_identity_policy.historical_reproduction_contract: completed recovery evidence; not rebound to the current gate contract and not consumed by the remaining smoke or formal long run
remaining_submission_identity_policy.external_asset_bundle: validate the resolved external asset root and marker before training
remaining_submission_identity_policy.formal_result_inventory: post-run integrity for untracked retained evidence only; not a pre-run admission gate or tracked cross-contract identity

failure_reporting.raw_record: the initiating failure is backfilled by the reviewed ledger; every subsequent nonzero PBS experiment exit or catchable scheduler signal writes failures/raw-<job-role-pid>.json under its exclusively authorized output root, while pre-authorization/reuse failures write below runtime_runs/S1-13/rejected-submissions without mutating the rejected root; commands at risk of reaching PBS walltime must have a pre-walltime timeout so capture retains execution time

reduced_correction_reproduction.topology: one real GPT-2 learner plus one CPU-only NumPy syncer on two distinct compute hosts
reduced_correction_reproduction.purpose: validate the long-smoke filesystem-path corrections before any five-node retry

runtime_health.unexpected_progress_heartbeat_gap: at most two times the median normal fragment-update completion interval through the target-reaching update
runtime_health.pending_stall: final learner publication and adoption queues are empty and syncer has no active or selected fragment
runtime_health.queue_growth: per-fragment pending and in-flight maxima remain at most one

long_run_preflight_smoke: five-node four-learner plus CPU-only syncer real Pythia/FineWeb-Edu smoke must prospectively sustain 58 of 60 publication opportunities before the formal long run; the formal minimum remains 2400 cycles
required_raw: frozen initial and final evaluation manifests for 9N
payload_retention: large tensor payloads remain in the bounded raw protocol root; the finalized package retains identities metadata classified tree snapshots and independently decodable small samples rather than duplicating all tensors
